title: Report subprocess execution
responsibility: Runs a command and captures bounded combined output and elapsed time.

inputs.name: reportProcess.command
inputs.description: Executable to spawn directly without a shell.

inputs.name: reportProcess.args
inputs.description: Arguments passed separately to the executable.

inputs.name: reportProcess.cwd
inputs.description: Optional working directory; otherwise the process inherits its current directory.

inputs.name: reportProcess.environment
inputs.description: Optional environment map replacing the child environment; defaults to process.env.

outputs.name: reportProcess
outputs.description: Promise resolving to exit code, combined stdout/stderr and duration in milliseconds. Keeps the last two million string characters; a null exit code becomes -1. Nonzero exit status is returned rather than thrown.
